originalTitle: Anthropic blocks users for anything touching training larger models
content: Shame on @DarioAmodei / Anthropic. I never distilled Claude—rollouts came from a strong open-source model; Claude just helped submit jobs and run analysis. Still got tagged for "training a competitor," and now anything touching RFT, SFT, or training larger models gets me blocked, Opus 5.5 downgrade…
chineseTitle: Anthropic 阻止用户进行任何涉及训练更大模型的事情
chineseContent: 为@DarioAmodei / Anthropic感到羞耻。我从来没有提炼过 Claude——推出来自强大的开源模型；克劳德只是帮助提交作业并进行分析。仍然被贴上“训练竞争对手”的标签，现在任何涉及 RFT、SFT 或训练更大模型的东西都会让我受阻，Opus 5.5 降级……
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
